queries.statement: SELECT @n = COUNT(*) FROM dbo.orders WHERE customer_id = @c
UPDATE dbo.orders SET note = REPLICATE(N'y', 1 + ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID())) % 190) WHERE id % 3 = 0

INSERT INTO dbo.orders (customer_id, status, total, note) SELECT TOP 300000 1 + ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID())) % 20000, CASE ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID())) % 3 WHEN 0 THEN 'new' WHEN 1 THEN 'paid' ELSE 'sent' END, ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID())) % 1000, REPLICATE(N'x', 100) FROM sys.all_objects a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b
SELECT status, COUNT(DISTINCT note) FROM dbo.orders GROUP BY status

SELECT RTRIM(object_name), RTRIM(counter_name), RTRIM(instance_name), cntr_value
	  FROM sys.dm_os_performance_counters
	  WHERE (object_name LIKE '%Buffer Manager%' AND counter_name = 'Page life expectancy')
	     OR (object_name LIKE '%Memory Manager%' AND counter_name = 'Memory Grants Pending')
	     OR (object_name LIKE '%SQL Statistics%' AND counter_name IN ('Batch Requests/sec', 'SQL Compilations/sec', 'SQL Re-Compilations/sec'))
	     OR (object_name LIKE '%Locks%' AND counter_name = 'Number of Deadlocks/sec' AND instance_name = '_Total')
	     OR (object_name LIKE '%Access Methods%' AND counter_name IN ('Page Splits/sec', 'Full Scans/sec'))
INSERT INTO dbo.audit SELECT TOP 50000 SYSDATETIME(), N'login' FROM sys.all_objects a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b
INSERT INTO dbo.customers (name) SELECT TOP 20000 CONCAT(N'c', ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT 1))) FROM sys.all_objects a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b

WITH ps AS (
	  SELECT object_id, index_id, SUM(page_count) pages,
	    CASE WHEN SUM(page_count) = 0 THEN 0
	      ELSE SUM(avg_fragmentation_in_percent * page_count) / SUM(page_count) END frag
	  FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, 'LIMITED')
	  WHERE alloc_unit_type_desc = 'IN_ROW_DATA' AND index_level = 0
	  GROUP BY object_id, index_id)
	SELECT TOP (@p1) sc.name, o.name, ISNULL(i.name, ''), i.type_desc, i.is_primary_key, i.is_unique, i.is_disabled,
	  ISNULL(ps.pages, 0), CAST(ISNULL(ps.frag, 0) AS float),
	  ISNULL(us.user_seeks, 0), ISNULL(us.user_scans, 0), ISNULL(us.user_lookups, 0), ISNULL(us.user_updates, 0),
	  (SELECT MAX(d) FROM (VALUES (us.last_user_seek), (us.last_user_scan), (us.last_user_lookup)) v(d))
	FROM sys.indexes i
	JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id = i.object_id AND o.is_ms_shipped = 0 AND o.type IN ('U', 'V')
	JOIN sys.schemas sc ON sc.schema_id = o.schema_id
	LEFT JOIN ps ON ps.object_id = i.object_id AND ps.index_id = i.index_id
	LEFT JOIN sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats us ON us.database_id = DB_ID() AND us.object_id = i.object_id AND us.index_id = i.index_id
	WHERE o.type = 'U' OR i.index_id > 0
	ORDER BY ISNULL(ps.pages, 0) DESC, sc.name, o.name, i.index_id

WITH ps AS (
	  SELECT object_id, index_id, SUM(page_count) pages,
	    CASE WHEN SUM(page_count) = 0 THEN 0
	      ELSE SUM(avg_fragmentation_in_percent * page_count) / SUM(page_count) END frag
	  FROM sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats(DB_ID(), NULL, NULL, NULL, 'LIMITED')
	  WHERE alloc_unit_type_desc = 'IN_ROW_DATA' AND index_level = 0
	  GROUP BY object_id, index_id)
	SELECT TOP (@p1) sc.name, o.name, ISNULL(i.name, ''), i.type_desc, i.is_primary_key, i.is_unique, i.is_disabled,
	  ISNULL(ps.pages, 0), CAST(ISNULL(ps.frag, 0) AS float),
	  ISNULL(us.user_seeks, 0), ISNULL(us.user_scans, 0), ISNULL(us.user_lookups, 0), ISNULL(us.user_updates, 0),
	  (SELECT MAX(d) FROM (VALUES (us.last_user_seek), (us.last_user_scan), (us.last_user_lookup)) v(d)),
	  ISNULL(STUFF((SELECT N',' + c.name FROM sys.index_columns ic
	    JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id
	    WHERE ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id AND ic.key_ordinal > 0
	    ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 1, N''), N'')
	FROM sys.indexes i
	JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id = i.object_id AND o.is_ms_shipped = 0 AND o.type IN ('U', 'V')
	JOIN sys.schemas sc ON sc.schema_id = o.schema_id
	LEFT JOIN ps ON ps.object_id = i.object_id AND ps.index_id = i.index_id
	LEFT JOIN sys.dm_db_index_usage_stats us ON us.database_id = DB_ID() AND us.object_id = i.object_id AND us.index_id = i.index_id
	WHERE o.type = 'U' OR i.index_id > 0
	ORDER BY ISNULL(ps.pages, 0) DESC, sc.name, o.name, i.index_id

SELECT TOP 25
	  LEFT(SUBSTRING(t.text, qs.statement_start_offset / 2 + 1,
	    (CASE qs.statement_end_offset WHEN -1 THEN DATALENGTH(t.text) ELSE qs.statement_end_offset END
	      - qs.statement_start_offset) / 2 + 1), 4000),
	  qs.execution_count, qs.total_worker_time / 1000,
	  qs.total_worker_time / 1000 / qs.execution_count, qs.total_elapsed_time / 1000 / qs.execution_count,
	  qs.total_logical_reads / qs.execution_count, qs.last_execution_time
	FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats qs
	CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) t
	CROSS APPLY (SELECT CONVERT(int, value) dbid FROM sys.dm_exec_plan_attributes(qs.plan_handle)
	  WHERE attribute = 'dbid') pa
	WHERE pa.dbid = DB_ID() AND qs.execution_count > 0
	ORDER BY qs.total_worker_time DESC

SELECT TOP (@p1) sc.name, o.name, st.name, st.auto_created, sp.last_updated,
	  ISNULL(sp.rows, 0), ISNULL(sp.rows_sampled, 0), ISNULL(sp.modification_counter, 0)
	FROM sys.stats st
	JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id = st.object_id AND o.is_ms_shipped = 0 AND o.type IN ('U', 'V')
	JOIN sys.schemas sc ON sc.schema_id = o.schema_id
	OUTER APPLY sys.dm_db_stats_properties(st.object_id, st.stats_id) sp
	ORDER BY ISNULL(sp.modification_counter, 0) DESC, sc.name, o.name, st.name

WITH w AS (SELECT wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms, signal_wait_time_ms FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats
	  WHERE wait_time_ms > 0 AND wait_type NOT IN ('BROKER_EVENTHANDLER','BROKER_RECEIVE_WAITFOR','BROKER_TASK_STOP','BROKER_TO_FLUSH','BROKER_TRANSMITTER','CHECKPOINT_QUEUE','CHKPT','CLR_AUTO_EVENT','CLR_MANUAL_EVENT','CLR_SEMAPHORE','DBMIRROR_DBM_EVENT','DBMIRROR_EVENTS_QUEUE','DBMIRROR_WORKER_QUEUE','DBMIRRORING_CMD','DIRTY_PAGE_POLL','DISPATCHER_QUEUE_SEMAPHORE','EXECSYNC','FSAGENT','FT_IFTS_SCHEDULER_IDLE_WAIT','FT_IFTSHC_MUTEX','HADR_CLUSAPI_CALL','HADR_FILESTREAM_IOMGR_IOCOMPLETION','HADR_LOGCAPTURE_WAIT','HADR_NOTIFICATION_DEQUEUE','HADR_TIMER_TASK','HADR_WORK_QUEUE','KSOURCE_WAKEUP','LAZYWRITER_SLEEP','LOGMGR_QUEUE','MEMORY_ALLOCATION_EXT','ONDEMAND_TASK_QUEUE','PARALLEL_REDO_DRAIN_WORKER','PARALLEL_REDO_LOG_CACHE','PARALLEL_REDO_TRAN_LIST','PARALLEL_REDO_WORKER_SYNC','PARALLEL_REDO_WORKER_WAIT_WORK','PREEMPTIVE_OS_FLUSHFILEBUFFERS','PREEMPTIVE_XE_GETTARGETSTATE','PVS_PREALLOCATE','PWAIT_ALL_COMPONENTS_INITIALIZED','PWAIT_DIRECTLOGCONSUMER_GETNEXT','PWAIT_EXTENSIBILITY_CLEANUP_TASK','QDS_ASYNC_QUEUE','QDS_CLEANUP_STALE_QUERIES_TASK_MAIN_LOOP_SLEEP','QDS_PERSIST_TASK_MAIN_LOOP_SLEEP','QDS_SHUTDOWN_QUEUE','REDO_THREAD_PENDING_WORK','REQUEST_FOR_DEADLOCK_SEARCH','RESOURCE_QUEUE','SERVER_IDLE_CHECK','SLEEP_BPOOL_FLUSH','SLEEP_DBSTARTUP','SLEEP_DCOMSTARTUP','SLEEP_MASTERDBREADY','SLEEP_MASTERMDREADY','SLEEP_MASTERUPGRADED','SLEEP_MSDBSTARTUP','SLEEP_SYSTEMTASK','SLEEP_TASK','SLEEP_TEMPDBSTARTUP','SNI_HTTP_ACCEPT','SOS_WORK_DISPATCHER','SP_SERVER_DIAGNOSTICS_SLEEP','SQLTRACE_BUFFER_FLUSH','SQLTRACE_INCREMENTAL_FLUSH_SLEEP','SQLTRACE_WAIT_ENTRIES','UCS_SESSION_REGISTRATION','VDI_CLIENT_OTHER','WAIT_FOR_RESULTS','WAIT_XTP_CKPT_CLOSE','WAIT_XTP_HOST_WAIT','WAIT_XTP_OFFLINE_CKPT_NEW_LOG','WAIT_XTP_RECOVERY','WAITFOR','WAITFOR_TASKSHUTDOWN','XE_BUFFERMGR_ALLPROCESSED_EVENT','XE_DISPATCHER_JOIN','XE_DISPATCHER_WAIT','XE_LIVE_TARGET_TVF','XE_TIMER_EVENT') AND wait_type NOT LIKE 'SLEEP[_]%')
	SELECT TOP 15 wait_type, waiting_tasks_count, wait_time_ms, signal_wait_time_ms,
	  CAST(100.0 * wait_time_ms / NULLIF(SUM(wait_time_ms) OVER (), 0) AS float)
	FROM w ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC

SELECT TOP 50 OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(d.object_id), OBJECT_NAME(d.object_id),
	  ISNULL(d.equality_columns, ''), ISNULL(d.inequality_columns, ''), ISNULL(d.included_columns, ''),
	  gs.user_seeks + gs.user_scans, CAST(gs.avg_user_impact AS float)
	FROM sys.dm_db_missing_index_details d
	JOIN sys.dm_db_missing_index_groups g ON g.index_handle = d.index_handle
	JOIN sys.dm_db_missing_index_group_stats gs ON gs.group_handle = g.index_group_handle
	WHERE d.database_id = DB_ID() AND OBJECT_NAME(d.object_id) IS NOT NULL
	ORDER BY gs.avg_total_user_cost * gs.avg_user_impact * (gs.user_seeks + gs.user_scans) DESC

SELECT actual_state_desc, readonly_reason, current_storage_size_mb, max_storage_size_mb
	  FROM sys.database_query_store_options

SELECT
	  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE blocking_session_id <> 0 AND database_id = DB_ID()),
	  ISNULL((SELECT DATEDIFF(SECOND, MIN(t.transaction_begin_time), SYSDATETIME())
	    FROM sys.dm_tran_database_transactions d JOIN sys.dm_tran_active_transactions t ON t.transaction_id = d.transaction_id
	    WHERE d.database_id = DB_ID() AND d.database_transaction_begin_time IS NOT NULL), 0)

SELECT
	  ISNULL(SUM(CAST(size_in_bytes AS bigint)), 0) / 1048576,
	  ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN objtype = 'Adhoc' AND usecounts = 1 THEN CAST(size_in_bytes AS bigint) ELSE 0 END), 0) / 1048576
	  FROM sys.dm_exec_cached_plans

SELECT name, CONVERT(nvarchar(64), value_in_use), CONVERT(nvarchar(400), description)
	  FROM sys.configurations WHERE name IN (N'max server memory (MB)', N'min server memory (MB)', N'max degree of parallelism', N'cost threshold for parallelism', N'optimize for ad hoc workloads', N'backup compression default', N'backup checksum default', N'remote admin connections', N'Agent XPs', N'clr enabled', N'xp_cmdshell', N'contained database authentication', N'max worker threads') ORDER BY name
SELECT [name] FROM [dbo].[customers] WHERE [id]=@1
SELECT [name] FROM [dbo].[customers] WHERE [id]=@1

SELECT recovery_model_desc, compatibility_level, is_auto_close_on, is_auto_shrink_on,
	  is_auto_create_stats_on, is_auto_update_stats_on, is_auto_update_stats_async_on, page_verify_option_desc,
	  is_read_committed_snapshot_on, snapshot_isolation_state_desc, is_query_store_on, target_recovery_time_in_seconds,
	  ISNULL(collation_name, ''), state_desc, user_access_desc, log_reuse_wait_desc, containment_desc, is_read_only, create_date
	  FROM sys.databases WHERE database_id = DB_ID()

SELECT name, type_desc, physical_name, CAST(size AS bigint) * 8 / 1024,
	  CAST(ISNULL(FILEPROPERTY(name, 'SpaceUsed'), 0) AS bigint) * 8 / 1024,
	  CASE max_size WHEN -1 THEN -1 WHEN 268435456 THEN -1 ELSE CAST(max_size AS bigint) * 8 / 1024 END,
	  CASE WHEN growth = 0 THEN 'none' WHEN is_percent_growth = 1 THEN CONCAT(growth, '%')
	    ELSE CONCAT(CAST(growth AS bigint) * 8 / 1024, ' MB') END, is_read_only
	  FROM sys.database_files ORDER BY file_id
SELECT sqlserver_start_time FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info
SELECT CAST(size AS bigint) * 8 / 1024 FROM tempdb.sys.database_files WHERE type = 0

SELECT CONVERT(nvarchar(128), SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion')),
	  CONVERT(nvarchar(128), SERVERPROPERTY('Edition')), sqlserver_start_time,
	  DATEDIFF(SECOND, sqlserver_start_time, SYSDATETIME()), cpu_count, physical_memory_kb / 1024,
	  committed_target_kb / 1024, committed_kb / 1024
	  FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info
SELECT physical_memory_in_use_kb / 1024 FROM sys.dm_os_process_memory
